models.name: Raon-1 mini
models.why: Hybrid sparse/linear attention: only 7 of its 25 layers keep a KV cache, so a full 262K context costs about 1-2 GiB and a 30B-class MoE stops being context-bound on an 8GB card; experts offloaded to CPU in both measured runs.

engines.hardware: RTX 3070 8GB + 64GB DDR4 (experts from 20 of 25 layers on CPU, 262K context loaded, 6.4GB VRAM)
engines.quant: Q4_K_M, 19.7GB GGUF file; KV at q8; KRAFTON's own llama.cpp branch (upstream does not load it yet)
engines.engine_min_version: KRAFTON's llama.cpp branch (upstream does not load it yet)

models.name: Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B
models.why: Reported 74B MoE on a 12GB RTX 3060 + 16GB RAM: Unsloth's UD-IQ1_S 1-bit GGUF beat NVIDIA's official 2-bit file by 3.5GB in size while matching perplexity (report; task benchmarks not shown).

engines.hardware: RTX 3060 12GB + 16GB system RAM (262K context; ~800 tok/s prefill, which is prompt processing, never the decode figure)

models.name: Qwen3.8-35B-A3B
models.why: Reported 35B-A3B at ~50 tok/s on a 12GB RTX 3060 with 16GB RAM via MoE expert offload; only ~3B parameters active per token.

engines.hardware: RTX 3060 12GB VRAM + 16GB system RAM (~550 tok/s prompt processing, which is prefill, never the decode figure)
engines.quant: Q4_K_M, 262K context configured, Flash Attention + 8-bit KV cache

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B
models.why: Hybrid GPU + system-RAM expert offload puts a 125B MoE on a single 24GB RTX 4090 at ~21 tok/s with no MTP, no DFlash2 and no KV-cache quantization (developer report).

engines.hardware: RTX 4090 24GB + 110GB DDR4 (hybrid offload, 40 expert layers on GPU; 384 tok/s prefill is prompt processing, never the decode figure; Ubuntu 22)
engines.quant: Q4_K_XL GGUF ~111.4GB across four shards; hybrid offload, no MTP, no DFlash2, no KV-cache quantization
